description: We’re cupcakkemas gang, a team of four uni students building SPHEREx Blink for the “Planet X and SPHEREx” challenge: a web tool where you enter a sky position and watch a time-lapse of real SPHEREx images, so moving objects like comets, asteroids and brown dwarfs stand out. Our skills: Python data pipelines, image processing, web frontend and documentation. Our team is full for this event, but we’re happy to share what we learn.
